[LGRA.2.8.1] A duration is written as a `time_expr`: a `UNIT_LIT` whose
`UNIT_SUFFIX` resolves to the `time` dimension, or a `NAME` that names a
constant whose value is a `Duration` ([LGRA.2.8.11]). The `UNIT_LIT`
production is defined **authoritatively** in [LLEX.12] and is not restated
here:

```
time_expr   ::= UNIT_LIT    ;; UNIT_LIT (LLEX.12), unit resolves to `time`
             |  NAME         ;; a constant whose value is a `Duration` (LGRA.2.8.11)
```
